attributes.name: Sister Perversion
attributes.powers:
Sister Perversion is immune to the Electricity and Poison traits.

Before you act, a random character at your location summons and encounters this adventure's servitor demon, then each character at your location must succeed at a Wisdom or Knowledge 12 check or expend 2 mythic charges.

If defeated, you may immediately attempt to close the location this henchman came from.
